title: Wilson Coefficients and Finite-Dimensional RG Systems

items.title: Finite renormalization schemes and Wilson coefficient vectors
items.design_state: Defines a fixed-weight complex quotient coefficient interface and supplied truncated RG data; no QFT beta function or omitted-term estimate is asserted.

references.title: Aneesh V. Manohar, Introduction to Effective Field Theories (2018 Les Houches full lecture notes)
references.locator: Chapter 2, §2 Renormalization, equations (6)–(11) and scale-dependence discussion; Chapter 4, §10 RG Improved Perturbation Theory, equations (49)–(52).

references.title: C. P. Burgess, Introduction to Effective Field Theory (full review)
references.locator: §§2.2.1–2.2.2 on the Wilson scale and renormalization; §4.1.3, equations (73)–(79), for physical and MS scheme conventions and running.

items.title: Local well-posedness of a supplied truncated coupled RG system
items.design_state: Complete local existence, uniqueness, and continuous-dependence proof for a supplied finite-dimensional realified beta field; no beta coefficients are calculated.

references.title: Gerald Teschl, Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems (author-hosted complete PDF)
references.locator: Chapter 2 §2.2, equations (2.10)–(2.20), Theorem 2.2 and its complete proof; compact-cylinder bounds and local Picard contraction.

references.title: A. Bouin, Cours Differential Equations, 2018–2019 (full lecture notes)
references.locator: §1.5, Theorem 1.5.4 and Lemma 1.5.5, PDF pp. 12–15; local contraction, first-exit uniqueness, and uniqueness on the common interval.

items.title: A two-component truncated RG flow with linear mixing
items.design_state: Exact two-component complex-linear flow on a supplied fixed-weight quotient; the matrix is stipulated and the explicit solution is verified.
